Query institution-level IPEDS data from S3

dot-ipeds_institution_query.Rd

Queries processed institution-level parquet files from S3 via DuckDB. Returns wide-format data — column structure varies by survey.

Usage

.ipeds_institution_query(
  survey,
  years = NULL,
  unitids = NULL,
  geoids = NULL,
  s3_bucket = "cori.data.ipeds",
  s3_path_prefix = ""
)

Arguments

survey

Character. One of "institutional_characteristics", "completions" (awards by program), "completers" (student headcounts by award level, 2012 onward), or "grad_rates".

years

Integer vector. Years to return. Default: all available.

unitids

Character vector. IPEDS unit IDs to return. Default: all.

geoids

Character vector. 5-digit county GEOIDs. Returns all institutions in those counties. Default: all.

s3_bucket

Character. Default: "cori.data.ipeds".

s3_path_prefix

Character. Default: "".

Value

A wide data frame, one row per institution and the survey's own dimensions: institution for institutional_characteristics, institution x CIP x award level x major number for completions, and institution x cohort type for grad_rates.

Columns are exactly the level == "institution" and level == "both" variables that get_ipeds_codebook() lists for that survey, plus year, plus survey (derived from the S3 partition path). The institutional_characteristics output additionally carries the derived flags is_public, is_nonprofit, is_forprofit, is_4yr, is_2yr, is_degree_granting, is_hbcu, and is_tribal.

Rather than enumerating columns here, query the codebook – it is the source the column selection is driven from, so it cannot drift: cb <- get_ipeds_codebook(); cb[cb$survey == "completions", ].

Note that completions retains NCES cipcode 99 rows (each institution's grand total across programs) and major_num 2 rows (second majors). Both are convenient at institution level but must be excluded before summing, or degrees are counted more than once; the county aggregations already exclude them.

Details

Because each survey has a different schema, only one survey can be queried per call. Use geoids to pull all institutions in one or more counties, then aggregate on your own terms.

See also

get_ipeds(), get_ipeds_codebook()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# All institutions in Grafton County NH
get_institutions(geography = "institution", geoids = "33009")

# Completions for a specific institution
get_degrees(geography = "institution", unitids = "182670")
} # }
